title: button-shortcut: Button accelerator / shortcut
summary: Button::shortcut(char) → composed Icon(NfIcon ⌃)+Label(letter) trailing slot inside the button; Ctrl+<c> self-submit + FocusManager::deliver_accelerator. Blocked on viewnode-all-widgets (Button) + gridui-03 NerdFont.
description:
Give a `Button` an explicit **accelerator** (`Ctrl+<letter>`) rendered **inside** the button as composed content, and wire it through the confirm/modal builders.

## STATUS: UNBLOCKED on the Button side (2026-07-13)
The blocker is gone: `Button` now **composes its content from children** (commit `07d4c1a`, PR #237) — it holds an arbitrary child tree and the size variant + state color cascade into it. So the accelerator is just **another child**, exactly as the design demands. Still blocked on **NerdFont embedding** (`gridui-03`) for the glyph.

## DESIGN LOCKED (user, rescued from the old root HANDOFF.md §2/§3b — do NOT relitigate)
- **Trigger: `Ctrl+<letter>`.** Chosen because it works in **confirm AND form dialogs** — a bare letter would collide with typing in an `Input`.
- **Rendered INSIDE the button**, as a **composed `Icon + Label`** child (the letter next to a control glyph). **NOT** hand-drawn `cx.icon`/`cx.text`, **NOT** placed adjacent to/outside the button. With the composition refactor landed, this is now natural: `.shortcut(c)` is **sugar that appends a child**, the same way `.icon(g)` prepends one.
- **The Button self-submits on `Ctrl+<c>`**; a host helper (`FocusManager::deliver_accelerator`) routes the accelerator to the matching **non-focused** button (otherwise only the focused button could be triggered).
- **`ModalAction.shortcut: Option<char>`**, set by the confirm builder. The **letter is semantic** — `n` = cancel/negative, `y` = confirm/positive — and must be assigned by the **caller/builder**, because a widget cannot infer that "Cancel" means "No".
- **Glyph: NerdFont, NOT Phosphor.** `Glyph::CaretUp` (codepoint `0xe13c`) was added for this and the user judged Phosphor's caret **ugly**. It **stays in the enum** (user directive: *keep it, do not remove*) but the accelerator uses a NerdFont control glyph instead.

## Work
1. **`gridui-03` first** — embed NerdFont (`NfIcon` + curated `NfGlyph`): vendor "Symbols Nerd Font Mono", confirm the license, add a renderer font family/role.
2. `Button::shortcut(char)` → appends a trailing composed child (`NfIcon(control) + Label(letter)`); the child inherits the button's state color + size variant for free (the composition foundations).
3. `Ctrl+<c>` self-submit in `Button::event`; `FocusManager::deliver_accelerator(root, char)` to reach a non-focused button.
4. `ModalAction.shortcut` + the confirm builder assigning `n`/`y`; `OverlayHost` passes it through when it builds the action buttons.
5. Docs per AGENTS.md: exhaustive, **both audiences** (native builder + the `ViewNode` prop), + showcase demo.

## Files
`heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/button.rs`, `heca-grid-ui/src/focus.rs`, `heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/icon.rs` (NfIcon), `heca/src/chrome/overlay.rs` (`ModalSpec`/`ModalAction`), `heca/src/actions.rs` (confirm builder), `docs/widgets.md`, showcase.

## Gates
clippy 0; `cargo test -p heca-grid-ui -p heca`; showcase green; no `cargo fmt`; rust SKILL review; user tests before commit.

tasks.title: Button::shortcut(char) — the letter shown inside the button as a Keycap, and pressing it presses the button
tasks.description:
REWRITTEN 2026-11-24 after a review against main (Antonio approved). The old blockers (`viewnode-task-2` content slot, `NfIcon`, `FocusManager::deliver_accelerator`) are no longer the path.

## Current state (verified 2026-11-24 on main)
- The `Keycap` widget exists (T469), used by the palette's shortcut column (heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/command_palette/view.rs:186).
- `Component::shortcut() -> Option<char>` exists (heca-grid-ui/src/component/behavior.rs:53) and its doc says a confirm Dialog fires the button whose `shortcut()` matches a typed letter — **but nothing implements it and nothing reads it.** It is a dead hook whose doc describes behaviour that does not exist.
- `Button` (heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/button/builders.rs) has label, icon, variants — no shortcut builder and no trailing content.
- Two key→glyph pieces exist side by side: heca/src/shortcut.rs `KEY_GLYPHS` + `chord_caps` → the app's own `KeyCap` type, and the library `Keycap` widget. Reuse one; do not add a third.

## What to build
`Button::new("Delete").shortcut('y')` → the button shows its label and, after it, a `Keycap` with the letter (composed child, not painted text). While the button's dialog/surface has the keyboard and no text field holds focus, typing the letter presses the button — the same press as a click (its `on_click` / intent), routed by the framework in the DOM-shaped key path, not by a host list.
Either make `Component::shortcut()` the real mechanism (Dialog or the focus scope reads it) or delete it in favour of the builder; never keep both.
Default: no shortcut, no layout change. Update docs/widgets.md (THE SYNTAX example) and the showcase.

## Check
Tests: the keycap is a child of the button; the letter presses it; it does not fire while an Input has focus. Antonio eye-checks the look.

tasks.title: Confirm dialogs give their buttons letters: y proceeds, n cancels (uses T273)
tasks.description:
REWRITTEN 2026-11-24 after a review against main (Antonio approved). Depends on P074/T273 (Button::shortcut).

## Current state (verified 2026-11-24 on main)
- Confirm dialogs are built from `ModalAction { id, label, danger, disable_when_empty }` (heca/src/chrome/surfaces/overlay/spec.rs:54) by heca/src/handlers/confirm.rs and the overlay host. No shortcut field.
- The library `Dialog` takes `.action(button)` (heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/dialog/builders.rs:160) and already presses the primary action on Enter (DialogPanel, T469).

## What to build
A confirm's proceed button gets `y`, its cancel button `n`, through `Button::shortcut` (T273) — set once where the confirm is built, not per caller. Rename and other dialogs with a text field get none (the letter would be typed into the field). Keep: the verb ("Delete"), the danger tint, the disabled-while-empty guard. Update docs.

## Check
Antonio: a delete-pane confirm shows y / n keycaps; y deletes, n cancels; a rename dialog shows none.
